name: Fikatsia Latrova
original_name: フィカーツィア・ラトロワ
source:
Commander of the Zhar Battalion, one of the Soviet’s top units. A pure-blooded Russian who leads a battalion of child soldiers from regions conquered by the Soviets, she is a veteran of many battles. A stern, military woman, but her unit looks up to her like a mother.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
